motions.purpose: Reveal an equation token by token in reading order, pacing the audience through the mathematics the way a lecturer writes it on a board.
motions.model: Reveal order equals reading order of the typeset equation; no mathematical content is generated or altered by the animation.
motions.limitations: Purely presentational pacing; the pen and stroke effects carry no mathematical meaning and are removed in export and reduced-motion modes.
motions.reducedMotion: The complete equation renders immediately with no pen and no partial ink.
motions.exportState: All ink units visible, pen removed, stroke paths fully drawn.
motions.accessibility: The equation root carries a spoken-language aria-label independent of animation state; Escape settles the sequence instantly.
